# Vigor Boost (vigorboost.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Vigor Boost, a male vitality dietary supplement in gummy form (60 gummies per bottle) offered to support energy, stamina and everyday vitality.

## Key facts
- Named ingredients: L-Citrulline, Pine Bark Extract, L-Carnitine, Vitamin B3 (Niacin), Zinc, Mucuna Pruriens Extract, Maca Root Extract, Grape Skin Extract; amounts are on the bottle panel
- Directions: the suggested daily serving printed on the bottle label
- Packs (USD): 1 bottle $69; 3 bottles $59 each ($177); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping); bonuses with 3 and 6 per the seller
- 60-day money-back guarantee, subject to the terms shown at checkout
- Not a treatment for any condition; adult men only; ask a doctor first if taking blood pressure, nitrate, blood-thinning or Parkinson's medicine
